notes.ٱسْم: QAC lemma ٱسْم is Lane اِسْمٌ, n20831 under سمو; never match the surface بسم (smile).
notes.ٱللَّه: QAC root اله is not used to choose among deity-related senses; the lemma selects Lane اللّٰهُ, n1123 under اله.
notes.سمو: Source root group سمو: n20811 سَمَا and n20831 اِسْمٌ. The name lemma takes precedence.
notes.رحم: Source root group رحم: n15076 verb رَحِمَهُ, n15091 الرَّحْمٰنُ and n15096 رَحِيمُ remain separate entries.
notes.حمد: Source root group حمد: n9032 verb حَمِدَهُ and n9039 noun حَمْدٌ remain separate entries.
